name: Den Designer
author: Chats
description: Make the Den your own. Place props from a searchable thumbnail catalog, rearrange existing scenery, and fine-tune your setup with 3D gizmos and numeric controls. Save shared or campaign-specific layouts, reuse compositions and presets, and restore stored props from the Storeroom. Includes independent prop-pack support, undo/redo, draft recovery, and rebindable controls. Decorations are saved separately from campaign saves. Runs entirely as a pak mod; UE4SS is not required.
